name: Bonito (Brazil)
description: Divided diagonally grey over green from the upper fly to the lower hoist, with a white star in each part, a yellow sun between coffee and sugar-cane branches and a scroll reading 1833 on the grey.
history: Bonito is a municipality in the state of Pernambuco, Brazil. According to the Commons description, the green stands for the forest and the grey for the agreste; the coffee and cane branches were the main crops, the star on the green is the district of Bentevi, the star on the grey Alto Bonito, the sun the town of Bonito itself and 1833 the year of political emancipation.
